site.name: Hudhud
site.tagline: An open research tool for tracking how media cover Yemen
site.demoBanner: DEMO DATA: some or all records on this page are synthetic and are not real news.
site.disclaimer: This platform describes media coverage. Sentiment, framing and topic labels are automated estimates with known error rates; they are not judgements of truth, and coverage volume is not a measure of importance or public opinion. Source orientation is documented with evidence and is not a reliability rating. Nothing here is a recommendation about any political actor.
site.license: Code MIT. Article texts remain the property of their publishers; the platform stores metadata and short excerpts only.

common.searchPlaceholder: Search headlines and excerpts in any language
common.noData: No data for this selection yet.

dashboard.title: Coverage at a glance
dashboard.intro: Daily monitoring of news coverage about Yemen across Yemeni, regional and international outlets in twelve languages.
dashboard.summaryNote: Generated from counts with a fixed template. It describes coverage, not events.
dashboard.splitNote: How outlets based in different areas framed the coverage in this period: share of each group's articles using each frame.

modules.news: Every article with its analysis and provenance.
modules.topics: Data-driven topics and curated themes, with trends.
modules.sources: The source registry: who publishes, from where, with what evidence.
modules.actors: Actors, the names outlets use for them, and how sentences about them read.
modules.events: Incidents reported in coverage, on a timeline and a map.
modules.landscape: Which outlets cover the same stories and republish each other.
modules.research: Search, compare and export data with citations.
modules.methodology: How every number on this site is produced, and its limits.

news.title: News
news.intro: Articles collected from registered sources. Exact duplicates are hidden; syndicated copies are marked.

article.separation: Each panel below is a separate analysis. They are never combined into a single score.
article.clusterNote: {n} articles from {s} outlets ({i} independent, not republished copies).
article.qualityNote: Technical completeness of the record only; not a credibility rating.
article.excerptNote: Excerpt as published in the feed. The full text is at the publisher.
article.noTargeted: No sentence about a named actor was clearly polar.

topics.title: Topics
topics.intro: Curated themes come from a fixed taxonomy. Data-driven topics are discovered by clustering article embeddings and are relabelled when the model is refitted.

sources.title: Sources
sources.intro: Every outlet the platform monitors, where its newsroom operates, and the evidence behind any orientation label.
sources.orientationNote: Orientation describes ownership, funding and stated editorial alignment, documented with evidence. It is not a measure of accuracy or reliability.
sources.storiesShared: Stories covered by all selected outlets

actors.title: Actors
actors.intro: Organisations, states and public figures in the knowledge base. The platform does not profile private individuals.
actors.aliasNote: Names are not neutral. Each alias is tagged with how it is typically used.
actors.targeted: How sentences about this actor read
actors.targetedNote: Measured per sentence that names the actor, with the sentence as evidence. It describes wording, not conduct, and is not an approval rating.

events.title: Reported events
events.intro: Incidents detected in coverage: a trigger word and a known place in the same sentence. These are reports, not verified incident data.

geography.title: Geography
geography.intro: How often coverage mentions each governorate, and the events reported there.

landscape.title: Media landscape
landscape.intro: Outlets are linked when they covered the same stories or republished each other's copy. Closeness here is about coverage overlap, not political agreement.
landscape.narrativesIntro: For the current filters, how each group of outlets framed and worded its coverage.

research.title: Research
research.intro: Hybrid search across languages, saved queries and citation-ready exports. Exports contain metadata and short excerpts, never full article texts.
research.semanticNote: Semantic search uses {model}. When the multilingual model is unavailable a character n-gram fallback is used, which does not match across languages.
research.apiNote: Everything here is also available through the public API.

quality.title: Data quality
quality.intro: How complete and reliable the collected data is right now.
quality.silent: Outlets with no articles in 7 days

admin.title: Admin
admin.intro: Pipeline operations. Requires the admin token configured on the server.
